Maria N.: Heads-up - finalizing plans for the Midwest LLM Meetup next Thursday. Need quick confirm on: demo kit, speaker slide check, swag pack counts, and lead capture flow. Who can own what? :spiral_calendar:

Kevin L.: I can take demo kit and power. Will verify laptops & chargers tomorrow.

Ash E.: I’ll own swag and speaker submissions. I have one pending talk that needs a biosheet from Alex - @Kevin can you nudge?

Kevin L.: Yep pinged Alex. Also we should reduce number of heavy hoodies - shipping cost spike. Recommend 120 tees, 60 stickers, 20 hoodies.

Sarah O.: Shipping window: Monday delivery to venue OR Wed pickup at storage unit. Leaning pickup unless carriers price drops. Ops prefers pickup.

Devon S.: For lead routing - we'll route demo signups to SF SDRs, and content-y leads to product marketing. Can we use QR -> Typeform + Zapier?

Maria N.: Yes QR -> Typeform -> Zapier -> Salesforce. Make sure form has a dropdown for "interest: demo / enterprise / research" so routing logic works.

Ash E.: Swag counts updated: 120 tees, 75 stickers (extra), 25 hoodies. Ordered yesterday, order #RDW-98321. ETA Fri.

ops-bot: Shipping label created: RDW-98321, carrier: ShipFast. Tracking: https://shipfast.example/track/RDW-98321

Kevin L.: Demo kit checklist (quick):
- 2x laptops (workload images verified)
- 1x HDMI -> USB-C dongle
- 2x battery packs
- 1x travel router (mobile hotspot)
- 1x extension power strip
- local model snapshot + sample prompts on desktop

I'll test image + hotspot tonight.

Sarah O.: Venue logistics: booth table 8ft, 2 chairs, 1 outlet (we requested 2). Freight door available at 08:00. Booth setup window 09:00-10:30.

Devon S.: Speaker confirmations: we have 2 accepted: Priya (10:45) and Omar (14:00). Need 5-min lightning slot for demo at 11:30 - @Ash can confirm speaker for that?

Ash E.: I can ask Jaime for the lightning demo. Also need slides uploaded 24h before. Send speaker slide upload link.

Maria N.: Draft copy for the meetup post: "Join Redwood at Midwest LLM Meetup - live demos, benchmark talk, and office-hours. Stop by booth B12 for swag & demos." Approve?

Kevin L.: Slight tweak: include "low-latency inference demos" and CTA "Scan the QR for exclusive benchmark whitepaper"

Devon S.: We'll gate the whitepaper behind the Typeform so we capture emails. Agree to Kevin's copy.

Sarah O.: Power contingency plan: bring a UPS for demo laptop. Recommend loaner battery + tested hotspot.

Kevin L.: UPS added to pack list. Also bringing a mini Ethernet switch in case venue Wi-Fi is flaky.

Ash E.: Swag packing plan (short): 6 boxes total - 2 tees, 1 stickers, 1 hoodies, 2 misc (lanyards, pens). Label boxes: A-F. Ops partner will inspect on pickup.

Maria N.: Lead routing mapping (quick):
- demo -> devon.sales@redwood.com
- enterprise -> account.execs@redwood.com
- research/partnerships -> research@redwood.com
Make sure Zapier mapping is live.

Devon S.: I'll validate Zap tonight and paste test record here.

Devon S.: Test record sent - received by SF queue. Works.

ops-bot: Reminder: Speaker slides due by 1764928800 (24 hours before event).

Ash E.: Jaime confirmed lightning slot. Slides coming by EOD tomorrow.

Maria N.: Two action items for final: 1) Kevin validate demo kit + hotspot (Kevin), 2) Ash confirm swag pick & speaker slides upload (Ash), 3) Sarah confirm pickup window & labels (Sarah), 4) Devon validates Zap (Devon). If anyone wants to swap, say now.

Kevin L.: Got it, I'll run a full smoke test at 19:00 PT and post results.

Sarah O.: I'll arrange pickup for Wed 08:30, driver: LogisticsLA, confirm when labels printed.

Ash E.: Printing labels now, will drop at storage by 17:30.

Maria N.: Great - if no blockers by EOD I'll post event reminder to social and pin demo signup link. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
